author: _DISTRACTION_
body:
The map developers are doing a thorough update to Conquest and want your feedback regarding changes we've proposed. Your opinion will matter, so it is important that you take this feedback survey seriously.

1. A flag spawns in the middle of the map, and you must capture the flag and hold it for the longest period of time for your team to win. This is known as King of the Flag - what optimizations would you add to the gamemode?

2. What is your favorite Conquest gamemode? KoTH, CTF, or TDM?

3. A shop that rewards users with items such as potions exclusively for Conquest would be known as the Conquest Shop and is planned for the upcoming update - what items would you suggest be added into it, excluding golden apples and arrows?

4. We tinkered with the idea of Free for All recently introduced onto Conquest, which is a Deathmatch gamemode that is "everyone for themselves". Would you be opposed to exploring more into the server hosting Free for All maps along with TDM/CTF/KoTH?

5. All deathmatch maps are planned to have scoreboxes to give users a tangible objective as an option rather than just killing players: this also adds an incentive for defense and offense within TDM. Do you personally enjoy playing to get scoreboxes, or do you prefer gaining points through kills?

6. Nexus is planned to be completely deprecated in this next Conquest update, and Conquest will not have kits across the board (maps may have kits per author request.) Are you okay with Nexus being removed?

title: Conquest Survey

replies.author: Skquid
replies.body:
1. It would need some unique looking maps, but other than that, sounds good 
2. CTF
3. Speed potions, special blocks you can place 
4.I wouldn't 
5. score boxes are better, it adds a different and interesting aspect to the game
6.I honestly don't know

replies.author: Riilo
replies.body:
1. Like squid said, having unique maps for this gamemode would make it very good. 
2. CTF
3. Golden apples, splash potions of speed, healing, jump boost, etc. 
4. I don't mind FFA actually, so yes. 
5. I would like scoreboxes and kills to be mixed. TDM by itself can be very boring, so scoreboxes give it a little bit more of an objective. 
6. I don't mind Nexus too much. I would enjoy it a lot more if there were many new maps (not the same ones we've been using since 2014/2015). Another idea that could make it more fun is people have to buy kits with credits but it could cause unfair gameplay. If Nexus was removed I wouldn't really care, but I wouldn't mind to keep it.

replies.author: Clijmart
replies.body:
1. Love this gamemode, needs cool map layouts to keep it interesting. Could work with Rage/Instakill quite well imo.
I always love it when things in maps change on certain events; If your team has the flag, you can't respawn or spawn somewhere else/with different items.
These kind of things keep it fun for me.

2. CTF by far, especially with building enabled.

3. In some maps enderpearls and rods may work. If possible, map features and team upgrades/events could be interesting too.
Hypixel Paintball may be a good source of inspiration.
Things like temp upgrades or boost sound fun to me.

4. I quite like FFA. In my opinion, the more (still similar ofcourse) games, the more variety and the less boring.
FFA would be nice with it.

5. I like Scorebox TDM way more then TDM with just kills. It adds more gameplay options and is way more exciting. Trying to push for something and having multiple strategy options, always great.

6. Wasn't a big fan of Nexus tbh. Whatever map it was, the gameplay was always the same. After 2 or 3 rounds, it just gets boring.
Having a kit map once in a while would be way better for me :)

replies.author: PokerFace
replies.body:
1. I'm not sure if I understand the gamemode completely, it sounds like there is no place to return the flag. Somebody could easily hide in their spawn with the flag and win the game.

2. KoTH. I love this gamemode because teams have to plan out their retake strategies.

3. Egg grenades.

4. The more FFA, the better. 

5. TDM without it is very stale. Strongly support requiring scoreboxes on each TDM map.

6. Please remove Nexus.
